FAQ

Need More Clarity?

Everything you need to know about Aiveo, in one place.

How many generations can I make per month?

Your monthly generation limit depends on your plan. Starter includes 200 generations, Creator offers 1,000, and Pro gives you unlimited. You can always check your remaining balance in the app.

Can I use my creations for commercial purposes?

Do I need a powerful device to run the app?

What export resolutions are available?

Is there a free trial for new newbies?

Can I switch plans later?
